summary: Full systematic verification of the Parent/Kids mode switcher + parental gate, 3 new games (Face the Feeling, Gratitude Garden, Worry Buster), Mood Match MongoDB migration, and Memory Cards medal re-verification. ALL 11 feature areas from the review request passed with no bugs found. Tested via Playwright on mobile viewport (390x844) using both testuser_rc1@example.com (non-premium) and admin@emoticoach.app (premium/admin).
critical_code_review_comments: mode.tsx: clean context implementation with AsyncStorage persistence (key ec_app_mode), correct gate-resolve callback pattern
ParentalGate.tsx: math challenge regenerates on wrong answer and on each open via useEffect(gateVisible) - correct behavior, verified live

(tabs)/_layout.tsx: correctly uses href: kidsMode ? null : undefined to hide Videos/Profile tabs in kids mode - this is the right Expo Router pattern (not conditional rendering which would break route registration)
profile.tsx: defense-in-depth check 'if (mode === kids) return locked view' executes BEFORE any real profile content renders, confirmed via direct URL navigation test (can't bypass via URL)

backend GET /api/games/mood-questions uses $sample aggregation with 101 seeded documents, count clamped 1-50, returns only situation+answer fields, auth required via Depends(get_current_user) - all correct

Minor nit (not a bug): mood-match.tsx has a 900ms setTimeout before advancing rounds while input is blocked by `picked` state - fine for UX but something to be aware of for any future rapid-click abuse testing

success_rate.backend: 100% (mood-questions endpoint verified via curl, random + correct shape)

seed_data_creation: None - used existing testuser_rc1 and admin accounts; mood_questions collection already auto-seeded by backend startup (confirmed 101 docs via API sampling)
